concerns.text: Verification says 'all 27 (3 d × 3 transform × 2 test... plus untransformed baseline) JSON files exist' — 3×3×2=18 (24 with baseline, 36 if baseline×2 tests). The count 27 matches no arithmetic; an implementer cannot deterministically decide how many files to produce. State the exact expected count and file-naming for the baseline.

T005 and T007 depend on 'shape strata from T003', but T003 only computes per-dataset skewness/kurtosis — no task defines how strata are constructed (how many strata, bin boundaries, stratum_id format). Without this, T005's 'one shape stratum' and T007's per-stratum output paths are not executable deterministically. Add the stratum-definition rule (e.g., skewness quartile bins) and stratum_id scheme.

T003 must record datasets with >10% missingness in datasets.csv with status 'filtered_out', but the dataset schema constrains missing_pct to maximum 10 — those rows cannot conform, and T002's verification ('schema per contracts/dataset.schema.yaml') becomes contradictory. Either the schema bound must be relaxed or the recording flow changed; as written the task is not executable as specified.

T006 generates only ≥1000 simulated datasets per effect size, but T008 sets validation_status='pass' iff bootstrap CI half-width ≤ 0.02 (SC-004). For power near 0.5, ~2400 iterations are needed for a 95% CI half-width of 0.02, so the pass criterion is statistically unreachable at the stated floor unless aggregation across strata is the intended mechanism — which is not stated. Raise the iteration floor or state explicitly that SC-004 applies to the aggregated (pooled) estimate.

concerns.text: Tasks write to results/type1_error/[stratum].json, results/power/*.json, results/aggregated/sensitivity_analysis.json, data/results/type1_error_pilot.json, while the plan and data model specify flat files (results/type1_error_results.csv, power_results.csv, sensitivity_results.csv). T012's verification ('every cited number matches a value in the result files') and the paper handoff need one authoritative layout; pick one and align.

T003 excludes datasets with 'no continuous variable', but the filter_reason enum has no corresponding value (normal, small_n, missing_too_high, no_group), so those exclusion rows cannot be validly encoded in datasets.csv. Add an enum value or map the case explicitly.

're-running the plotting step reproduces byte-identical figures' is achievable with matplotlib only if metadata timestamps are suppressed (e.g., savefig metadata={'Software': None} or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH); note this requirement or relax to 'visually identical / same data values'.
